meta.name: Purification Session
meta.description: The Cleansing Session - Tarot is about the experiences of a young woman who tells her tarot fortune to others. Tugba, a young woman, had a fortune teller read tarot readings, and it soon came out. The fortune teller warns Tuğba that what she tells in fortune telling is kept confidential. However, Tuğba tells the information that the fortuneteller wants to be kept confidential at Club House. After this situation, Tugba's life suddenly becomes chaotic and cursed.
